description: This is the source code for the 'git difftool' builtin command, implementing functionality to facilitate difftool operations within the git version control system. It includes functions for configuration, parsing index information, handling symbolic links, and executing diff tools, supporting both file-by-file and directory-based diffs.

methods.name: int difftool_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Configures difftool options based on git configuration variables.

methods.name: int print_tool_help(void)
methods.description: Runs a command to display help information for available diff tools.

methods.name: int parse_index_info(struct repository * repo,char * p,int * mode1,int * mode2,struct object_id * oid1,struct object_id * oid2,char * status)
methods.description: Parses a line of index information, extracting file modes, object IDs, and status.

methods.name: void add_path(struct strbuf * buf,size_t base_len,const char * path)
methods.description: Appends a relative path to a strbuf, ensuring proper slash handling.

methods.name: int use_wt_file(struct repository * repo,const char * workdir,const char * name,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines if a working tree file can be reused based on its object ID.

methods.name: char * get_symlink(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const struct object_id * oid,const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves the target contents of a symlink or stored object for diffing.

methods.name: int checkout_path(unsigned mode,struct object_id * oid,const char * path,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Checks out a specific file from an object ID to a given path.

methods.name: void write_file_in_directory(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * dir,size_t dir_len,const char * path,const char * content)
methods.description: Writes content to a file within a specified directory, creating leading directories as needed.

methods.name: void write_standin_files(struct repository * repo,struct pair_entry * entry,struct strbuf * ldir,size_t ldir_len,struct strbuf * rdir,size_t rdir_len)
methods.description: Creates placeholder files for submodules and symlinks for diffing.

methods.name: int run_dir_diff(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const char * extcmd,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Performs a directory diff using a temporary directory structure and external diff viewer.

methods.name: int run_file_diff(int prompt,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Performs a diff for individual files, optionally prompting the user.

methods.name: int cmd_difftool(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git difftool' command, handles options, configuration, and dispatches to diff routines.
